A volcanic caldera filled with black ash, the remains of thousands buried standing upright in the cooling rock, their outstretched arms breaking the surface in rows without end.
A cursed library where every book is bound in pale leather, the shelves tended by hunched and silent dead, the text on every page shifting when read by living eyes.
